data.title: Opening
content: #h1 Where I Hope English Will Take Me in 10 Years
I hope English will help me enter the cybersecurity field in the future.
I want to use English to learn about cybersecurity, communicate with people from different countries, and understand technical information.

data.title: Future Goals
content: In the future, I hope to work in the field of cybersecurity.
English is important because many cybersecurity resources, documentation, courses, tools, and communities use English.

data.title: English for Technology
content: English is widely used in technology and computer science.
- firewall = sistem yang membantu menyaring lalu lintas jaringan
Understanding these words can make it easier to read technical documentation and communicate about technology.

data.title: Speaking About My Future
content: Beberapa pola yang dapat digunakan untuk membicarakan rencana dan harapan masa depan:
- In the future, I want to...
In the future, I want to work in cybersecurity. I hope English will help me learn new technologies and communicate with people around the world.

data.title: Rangkuman Tufel
content: English can be useful for achieving future goals, especially in technology-related fields.
My goal is to explore cybersecurity in the future and use English as a tool for learning, communication, and understanding technical information.
English, future, goal, cybersecurity, technology, network, server, database, security, communication.
